verdict.rationale: Render's own site directly claims load-based autoscaling built to absorb large traffic bursts, which matches the story as written. A community user independently confirms that Render supports autoscaling. However, the evidence is a single marketing line plus a brief community mention, with no configuration documentation. missing for 10: documentation of autoscaling configuration (metric targets, min/max instance limits, scale-up speed), and hands-on or independent evidence that bursts are actually absorbed under load.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on load-based autoscaling to absorb large traffic bursts automatically

citations.quote: Load-based autoscaling that handles 100x traffic bursts and beyond
they support distributed Elixir out of the box as well as autoscaling
